name: dripos-crm-mcp

tools.name: drip_whoami
tools.description: Validate DRIP_API_TOKEN against the hosted backend and report which business it belongs to, the key mode (test/live), the active safety gates (read-only / live-write), and which CRM capabilities this token can reach (lead search, managed inboxes). Call this first in a session.

tools.name: drip_search_leads
tools.description: Compile a natural-language lead request ("find 25 CTOs at seed-stage fintechs in NYC hiring backend engineers") into a reviewable structured search plan WITHOUT running the search or spending search budget. Returns the plan clauses (axis / mode / values), any requirements the compiler could not represent (unresolvedRequirements = the plan cannot run as-is) and any it distilled out as best-effort preferences (distilledRequirements), plus enforcement checks. Pass the returned `plan` object to drip_run_lead_search as approvedPlan to execute exactly what was reviewed. Read-only; rate-limited server-side.

request.description: Natural-language description of the leads you want (who, where, what signal), max 2000 chars

planVersion.description: Plan contract version: 2 (default) = structured clause plan with distilled-requirement reporting; 1 = legacy chip plan. Version 3 is retired server-side.

businessProfile.description: Optional ICP context that biases compilation (titles/industries/companySizes/geos/signalTopics)

tools.name: drip_run_lead_search
tools.description: Execute a hosted lead search end-to-end (discovery → account matching → contact resolution → verification → ranking) and return ranked, campaign-ready results with the funnel-diagnostics line. SPENDS BUDGET: each run reserves AI credits + vendor spend on the workspace and counts against the per-business daily search cap. Prefer the two-step flow: drip_search_leads first, then pass the returned plan here as approvedPlan (exact reviewed execution). Without approvedPlan the run is exploratory (unstructured fallback allowed). Long runs: the tool waits up to waitSeconds (default 300) with progress notifications, then returns the idempotencyKey so drip_get_lead_run can fetch the finished result (stored ~24h).

request.description: Natural-language lead request. When approvedPlan is set, keep the same request the plan was compiled from.

count.description: Target lead count for exploratory runs. FORBIDDEN with approvedPlan (the plan carries its own count).

approvedPlan.description: The `plan` object exactly as returned by drip_search_leads. Preview metadata is stripped automatically.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for safe retries/polling. Auto-generated when omitted; always echoed back.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for completion before returning the poll handle (default 300)

tools.name: drip_get_lead_run
tools.description: Fetch a past (or still-running) lead-search run by the idempotencyKey returned from drip_run_lead_search. Terminal results are replayed exactly as stored (kept ~24h). A running search returns status "running" — retry shortly.

idempotencyKey.description: The run handle echoed by drip_run_lead_search

tools.name: drip_list_lead_runs
tools.description: Aggregate bookkeeping for past lead-search runs over a day window: run counts by status/source, funnel sums (candidates → qualified → importable), spend reserved vs reconciled, latency, feedback/outcome tallies. HONESTY NOTE: the hosted backend has no per-run LIST endpoint — individual runs are addressable only by idempotencyKey (drip_get_lead_run, ~24h retention). A true run list is roadmap (see README).

tools.name: drip_list_inboxes
tools.description: List managed sender mailboxes and managed email domains for the workspace, with provisioning / DNS / authentication / pacing status per row. CAVEAT: mailbox health/status reporting has known gaps (app-side wave-2 fixes in flight) — treat readiness flags as advisory, and verify in the app before relying on a mailbox for live sends.

includeDomains.description: Also fetch managed domain rows with DNS status (default true)

tools.name: drip_provision_inbox
tools.description: Provision ONE managed email domain plus its sender mailboxes in a single order (Icemail-backed Google Workspace or Microsoft 365). BILLED: requires the managed-email subscription; each mailbox is a recurring cost. Returns the created domain (with DNS/provisioning state) and mailbox rows. Provisioning + DNS verification continue asynchronously — poll with drip_list_inboxes. CAVEAT: mailbox health/status reporting has known gaps (app-side wave-2 fixes in flight) — treat readiness flags as advisory, and verify in the app before relying on a mailbox for live sends.

domain.description: The sending domain to provision (e.g. "getdrip-mail.com"). One order = one domain.

provider.description: Mailbox provider backing the managed domain

localPart.description: Local part of the address (the "nick" in nick@domain)

mailboxes.description: Sender mailboxes to create on the domain (1-50)
